name: Moon
tagline: Earth's only natural satellite — the first world visited by human beings.
history: The Moon most likely formed about 4.5 billion years ago when a Mars-sized body — named Theia — struck the young Earth, and the ejected debris coalesced in orbit. Tidally locked, it always shows the same face. Twelve Apollo astronauts walked its surface between 1969 and 1972, returning 382 kg of rock that anchors lunar chronology. The Moon drifts about 3.8 cm farther from Earth each year. It is now the target of NASA's Artemis program, which aims to return humans — including the first woman — this decade and establish a sustainable presence near the south pole's ice-bearing craters.
